title: Nexus WorldKbKeyBlockStateResponse
description: Read projection for GET /v1/daemon/worlds/{world_id}/kb/key-blocks/{key_block_id}/state (V1.114 P2). Surfaces the mutable runtime state of a computable KeyBlock plus its computability flag and per-row OCC version.

state.description: The block's body.state when computable; null when non-computable or when computable but no state is present.

is_computable.description: True when the KeyBlock's body.computable is true.

version.description: Per-row OCC revision (kb_key_blocks.revision, NULL normalized to 0).
